summary: Session 3 of 3 (template-scaffolding-followup-fixes): Removed NU5110/NU5111 pack warnings from Dabbler.Templates and authored the set's change-log.md. Root cause: NuGet flags any .ps1 file anywhere in a package with NU5110/NU5111; Apply-T1EntitySchema.ps1 is a post-scaffolding developer helper, not a NuGet install script — a false-positive for template packages. Fix: renamed Apply-T1EntitySchema.ps1 to Apply-T1EntitySchema.dabbler-ps in the template source directory; added a sources[].rename entry to dabbler-crud-page/.template.config/template.json mapping the .dabbler-ps source path to Apply-T1EntitySchema.ps1 on scaffold output. The existing entity/entityPlural fileRename symbols apply token substitution to the rename target, producing Apply-{Entity}Schema.ps1 in the developer's project. No NoWarn added to Dabbler.Templates.csproj — warnings are eliminated by removing the .ps1 from the package, not by suppressing detection. Full validation bundle: dotnet pack (zero NU5110/NU5111), nupkg inspection (Apply-T1EntitySchema.dabbler-ps present; no .ps1 in package), scaffold smoke (Apply-ProductSchema.ps1 correctly emitted), tools/pack.ps1 (30 packages, no warnings), PackagingSmokeTests 4/4, Dabbler.CrudSlice.Tests 29/29. change-log.md authored covering all 3 sessions with deferred items listed.
